content: Baan a Nzam
Taaràbi kikwen mbɔɔn, lalan kipɛ nde kab: bi bibeelà baan a Nzam, ndandaa bi ibà abwɛy! Kyakin, mɛɛn miyöb anki, ntɔn ma màyöb anki Nzam.
Ankwen amɛ, sɛmà apanà bi ibà baan a Nzam, wɛɛ ayà isàkal bi ŋàtàmɛnà anki. Bi ikyàyöb naa umpal usàmɛnà nde, bi isàkal asànaa nde, ntɔn bi isuman asànaa awà nde.
Mbuur wanswà an'sà làkyän amu nde, wàmupööŋ nde ŋakwo asànaa Yɛsu Klistɔ ŋakwo wàŋàpɔŋà.
Mbuur awà an'kyer man'be, an'kyer sye ube, ntɔn man'be mà ube.
Wɛɛ bɛ làkyàyöb naa nde kàyàmɛnà ntɔn mulwom man'be, amu nde man'be matɛy.
Mbuur wanswà awà amu nde ufàkyer anki man'be. Mbuur wanswà afàkyer man'be, wàmuswaŋ naa nde kun'mɛn anki anà kun'yöb anki.
Baan amɛ, mbuur twon kàlabwiy ndwaŋ! Mbuur awà afàkyer ndaa a balàbal, wà balàbal, asànaa Klistɔ ŋakwo wà balàbal.
Mbuur afàkyer man'be wà mbuur a ileŋ, ntɔn ileŋ afàkyer man'be fà nsɛmà. Mwan a Nzam kàyàmɛnà ntɔn mudwa isal a ileŋ.
Mbuur awà bàbör amu Nzam, ufàfàkyer anki man'be, ntɔn mbɛŋ ande yan'bwaay amu nde, nde ufàkwo anki mukyer man'be, ntɔn Nzam wà Taarànde.
Le undiir afàpà nsöön ubwaŋàbwaŋ uboo a baan a Nzam anà baan a ileŋ: mbuur wanswà mpa afàkyer balàbal, itàkal mpa afàkwen un'tɔŋ ande, kà wà mwan a Nzam anki.
Ntɔn alà làsaŋ làwem bɛ fà nsɛmà: wɛy bi ikwen bi a bi.
Wɛy bi ikɔ̈ɔ̈n akyer asànaa Kayin awà kàkäl mbuur a Un'be, waa kàdwä utɔŋ ande. Ntɔn nkye kun'dwä nde? Ntɔn isal ande byàkäl byà ibe, wɛɛ byà un'tɔŋ ande byàkäl byà balàbal.
Atɔŋ, twon lan'man ndaa yà ubem, isàkal naa mɛɛn màmàlayiiŋ.
Bi, bi ikyàyöb naa bi bàfü kà ukwà tii uboo a mɔ̈ɔ̈, ntɔn bi ifàkwen atɔŋ. Mbuur mpa awà anà ukwen, wà uboo a ukwà.
Ntɔn mbuur awà un'yiiŋ a un'tɔŋ ande wà un'dwää. Anà bɛ làkyàyöb naa akà un'dwää mwɛy awe anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye amu nde watɛy.
Le, apanà bi ban'yöb ukwen: Yɛsu Klistɔ kàpɛ mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande ntɔn bi. Bi sye ikyer asànaa nde, bi ipà mɔ̈ɔ̈ abi ntɔn atɔŋ.
Isàkal naa mbuur u mɛɛn mà we anà indiir mbɔɔn, nde umɛn un'tɔŋ ande u mpay, wɛɛ nde kun'kääŋ mpem, ukwen a Nzam ban'kwo mukal aben amu nde?
Baan amɛ, wɛy bi ikɔ̈ɔ̈n akwen nà u ndaa anà làlem mpɛl, wɛɛ unsà isal anà u ndandaa.
Làkyän kusà a Nzam
Abun, bi waa isàyöb naa bi ibà baar a ndandaa, anà mpem abi waa isàkal yà duu kusà a Nzam.
Ntɔn, itàkal naa mpem abi yàmukifüünà, bi ikyàyöb naa Nzam kan'söön mpem abi anà nde akyàyöb indiir byanswà.
Atɔŋ amɛ bànkwen, isàkal naa mpem abi ikifüünà anki, bi ibye anà làkyän kusà a Nzam.
Abun, bi isàwal undiir wanswà isàlɔm bi akà nde, ntɔn bi ban'kyey nswɛɛŋ ande anà bi ifàkyer ukwen ande.
Le nswɛɛŋ ande: bi musà làkwikilà kà ikɔb a Mwan ande Yɛsu Klistɔ anà bi ikwen bi a bi, asànaa kiswɛŋ nde.
Mbuur afàsyäl nswɛɛŋ ande wà wà Nzam, anà Nzam wà amu nde. Apan, bi ban'yöb naa nde wà uboo a bi, u mbwo a Dweelà kipɛ nde.
